arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BOUNDARY.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-RISK-RATING PIC X.
01 WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC PIC 9(2).
01 WS-KYC-DUE PIC X VALUE "N".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
ACCEPT WS-RISK-RATING
ACCEPT WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC
EVALUATE WS-RISK-RATING
 WHEN "H"
 IF WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC > 2 MOVE "Y" TO WS-KYC-DUE END-IF
 WHEN "M"
 IF WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC >= 8 MOVE "Y" TO WS-KYC-DUE END-IF
 WHEN OTHER
 IF WS-YEARS-SINCE-KYC >= 10 MOVE "Y" TO WS-KYC-DUE END-IF
END-EVALUATE
DISPLAY "KYC-DUE: " WS-KYC-DUE
STOP RUN.
